title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Visits)
(1) Where any of the following persons applies to visit an admitted foreigner, the head, etc. shall permit the visit:
1. A consular officer of the country of which the admitted foreigner is a national or citizen;
2. An attorney who is or intends to become the admitted foreigner's litigation representative or defense counsel;
3. A commissioner or employee of the National Human Rights Commission handling a petition concerning the admitted foreigner.
(2) Visiting hours shall be within working hours under the main sentence of Article 9 (2) of the State Public Officials Service Regulations.
(3) Visits shall take place in a separately designated area within the departure waiting room: Provided, That where a visit is difficult in such designated area, the head, etc. may permit it in another appropriate space within the departure waiting room.
(4) Responsible officials, etc. shall not participate in a visit and shall not listen to or record its contents.
(5) Where an admitted foreigner for whom a visit has been requested is removed before the visit, the head, etc. shall inform the applicant in advance.
(6) Notwithstanding paragraphs (1) through (5), the head, etc. may restrict the number of visitors or the time, place, and method of visits where there is a significant risk of serious interference with the safety and order of the departure waiting room.
